---
id: env.excl.known-conditions
type: exclusion
heading: Known Conditions
since: 1.0.0
status: draft
---

A pollution condition that a member of your control group knew about, or could reasonably have been expected to know about, before the start of the first policy period in which we insured you without interruption under the section concerned, unless it was disclosed to us in writing and accepted in the schedule.
